qa_method: Article-by-article review of the P3-CONF-001 CONFIRMATION decisions. P3 is a confirmation / retain track (not expansion): the existing internal Chinese candidate for each article is already usable as internal reference. For each article the QA verifies: the retain decision is appropriate, the candidate is retained verbatim by hash (no new Chinese text generated, nothing modified), the semantic-QA finding (alignment high, completeness near-full, recommended action retain-as-internal-reference-candidate) is re-confirmed, source traceability (Arabic governing / existing candidate / semantic QA / P3 backlog links & hashes) holds, and the official-status boundary (internal / non-official / non-binding / non-governing) is preserved. Review only — no confirmation data, no Chinese candidate, and no other layer was modified. Hashes/references only; no full Arabic/English/Chinese text embedded.
